Roshan calls Bhide frantically asking about Sodhi. To save Sodhi from getting kicked out of his home, Bhide lies and claims Sodhi is peacefully talking with the brothers inside, and that they have to stay overnight for dinner to prevent the fight from flaring up again.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
